title: Implement POST /api/generate/prospect/[slug]/section route
description: Create the route that regenerates a single section for a prospect. Used by the editor's 'Regenerate Section' button. Runs stage 3 (content generation) for just one section and patches page_data.
acceptanceCriteria: Regenerates content for just that section using the AI
Updates the page_data for that section in the DB
Verify by calling the endpoint and checking the DB

steps.details: Export POST handler. Load prospect by slug. Parse sectionType from body. Call `regenerateSection(prospect, sectionType)` from TASK-50. Patch the prospect's page_data at that section key. Return the updated section.
Load existing page_data. Replace the section entry matching the sectionType. Stringify and save via `updateProspect(slug, { page_data })`. Return the new section content.
Call POST /api/generate/prospect/[slug]/section with { sectionType: 'hero' }. Verify 200 response with updated hero content. Check DB that page_data hero section changed.
